events.speaker: CLEMENTINE
events.text: Both hands flat on the cloth. Press until I say otherwise. It will bleed worse before it slows, and if you look away from it, it will bleed worse than that.

events.speaker: CLEMENTINE
events.text: He will keep till morning. You handed me things in the order I asked for them and you did not once ask a question. Men in uniform managed less than that, and they had been trained to it.

events.speaker: CLEMENTINE
events.text: I have carried this kit through country meaner than yours. Feed me, let me sleep near the wagon, and it comes along. I want no other terms.

events.speaker: CLEMENTINE
events.text: I do not say soft things and I am not about to learn. You had my hands full and my back to an open door, and I was not afraid the whole time. Take that instead. It is worth more.
